name: Methysergide

similar.name: Ergotamine
problems: Pulled from the market in New Zealand, first in 2019 — for blood vessel problems and heart harm
Carries a boxed warning in United States

summary: Methysergide received low risk scores for liver and heart harm based on a small computer model rather than tests on people [M]. The drug is similar to another medicine named Ergotamine [3]. Ergotamine carries a boxed warning in the United States and was pulled from the market in New Zealand starting in 2019 due to blood vessel issues and heart harm [3].
